syllabus_topics: Classification and principles of diffusion separation processes and operations.
Basis of mass transfer.
Basis of distillation.
Basis of rectification.
Types of rectification processes.
Absorption basis.
Absorption processes design.
Design of rectification and absorption columns.
Extraction processes design.
Design of extraction processes and apparatuses.
Adsorption basis.
Design of adsorption processes and equipment.
Membrane operations.
Crystallization and crystallizers.
Basic equations and quantities in mass transfer, phase equilibrium, molecular diffusion, convective mass transfer.
Absorption column calculation, differential balance, determination of column height.
Single continuous distillation of a binary mixture.
Expansion distillation (flash).
Rectification column, calculating the number of distillation trays.
Extraction, calculation of single-stage equipment, multi-stage system.
Adsorption column - equilibrium, the equipment design.
Membrane operations, calculation of mass flux through a membrane, concentration polarization.
bibliography: Ditl, P.: Difussion Separation Processes, Text book, Czech Technical University and mostly English literature recommended in this text book.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
